entities.summary: Darius Denayr Bazley is an American professional basketball player for the Ningbo Rockets of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA). He attended Princeton High School in Sharonville, Ohio after playing his first two years at Finneytown High School. He was a consensus five-star recruit and the top prospect in his state, earning McDonald's All-American honors in 2018.
